COMMAND.name: reboot
COMMAND.help: Halt and perform a cold restart

COMMAND.name: save
COMMAND.ACTION: if test ! -S "${RT_SOCK}"; then echo "error: socket not ready.." echo "${RT_SOCK}" exit 33 elif test -S "${RT_SOCK}"; then ${RT_BIN}/konf -s "${RT_SOCK}" -- -s -l "! version ${RT_CONF_VER}" -r "^! version" ${RT_BIN}/konf -s "${RT_SOCK}" -- -s -l "! last commit: `date`" -r "^! last" "! version ${RT_CONF_VER}" fi echo "Save running-config to startup-config.."; sleep 0.35 # Titik tersembunyi .last-save untuk `rollback` polos # (kembali ke startup-config dengan fidelitas penuh: # bird.conf + bird.d + netstate + sysctl ikut dipotret, # karena `save` sendiri tidak memotretnya). Best-effort: # gagal memotret TIDAK PERNAH menggagalkan save. ${RT_SBIN}/titian-checkpoint.sh snapshot-last-save 2>/dev/null || echo "peringatan: snapshot .last-save gagal (save tetap berhasil)"
